job_target.zh: 数据科学家 / AI 产品分析师

job_tagline.en: Statistics & AI background | Seeking data-driven product & analysis roles
job_tagline.zh: 统计与AI背景 | 寻求数据驱动产品与分析方向机会

about.en: Interdisciplinary background in statistics and data analytics with hands-on experience in AI/ML projects including fraud detection, multimodal content moderation, and computer vision. Proven ability to lead technical teams, design end-to-end data pipelines, and deliver actionable insights. Passionate about bridging data science with AI product development.
about.zh: 具备统计与数据分析的复合学科背景，在欺诈检测、多模态内容审核和计算机视觉等 AI/ML 项目中拥有实战经验。能够主导技术团队、设计端到端数据管道并交付可落地分析洞察。热衷于连接数据科学与 AI 产品开发。

detail.en: Wu Jieh Yee School of Interdisciplinary Studies — Statistics and Data Analytics Track

school.en: Changsha University of Science and Technology

description.en: Applied SMOTE oversampling on highly imbalanced data (0.17% fraud) and compared Logistic Regression vs Random Forest — improved recall from 0.55 to 0.94. Optimized classification threshold via Precision-Recall curve. Designed multi-model risk control framework with three-tier disposition (auto-approve / secondary review / auto-block).
description.zh: 针对极度不平衡数据（欺诈仅占0.17%）采用SMOTE过采样，对比逻辑回归与随机森林，将召回率从0.55提升至0.94。基于Precision-Recall曲线优化分类阈值。设计多模型协同风控框架及三级处置机制（自动放行/二次验证/自动拦截）。

title.en: Artificial Intelligence Systems for Automatic Content Review
title.zh: 人工智能自动内容审核系统

description.en: Designed a multimodal fusion pipeline with BERT text encoder and ResNet image encoder, using confidence-based weighting for cross-modal risk detection. Built dynamic user risk profiles enabling three-tier review. Implemented explainable output with human-in-the-loop feedback.
description.zh: 设计基于BERT文本编码器与ResNet图像编码器的多模态融合检测框架，通过置信度融合加权识别跨模态隐蔽恶意内容。构建动态用户风险画像实现三级差异化审核机制。引入可解释输出与人机协同闭环。

description.en: Built end-to-end pipeline: video input → YOLOv11 detection → grayscale/contrast enhancement → EasyOCR recognition → annotated output. Converted PASCAL VOC annotations to YOLO format. Achieved detection mAP 0.89 and recognition accuracy > 92%.
description.zh: 实现"视频输入→YOLO预处理→车牌定位→字符分割→OCR识别→结果输出"端到端流程。将PASCAL VOC格式标注转换为YOLO格式。系统达成检测mAP 0.89、识别准确率>92%。

en: Fraud detection & anomaly detection in financial data
Multimodal AI for content safety and moderation
Computer vision for intelligent surveillance systems
zh: 金融数据中的欺诈检测与异常检测
多模态AI内容安全与审核
